name: OMMA
summary: Methoxyphenamine, also known as 2-methoxy-N-methylamphetamine (OMMA), is a β-adrenergic receptor agonist of the amphetamine class used as a bronchodilator.

pharmacology.text: Methoxyphenamine (trade names ASMI, Euspirol, Orthoxine, Ortodrinex, Proasma), also known as 2-methoxy-N-methylamphetamine (OMMA), is a β-adrenergic receptor agonist of the amphetamine class used as a bronchodilator. It acts as an anti-inflammatory in rats.

uses.text: Methoxyphenamine (trade names ASMI, Euspirol, Orthoxine, Ortodrinex, Proasma), also known as 2-methoxy-N-methylamphetamine (OMMA), is a β-adrenergic receptor agonist of the amphetamine class used as a bronchodilator.

summaryZh: 甲氧那明，化學式C11H17NO，安非他命衍生物的一種，是一種支氣管擴張藥，主要作用於β腎上腺素受體。

sideEffects.en: It can cause trembling, palpitations, a fast heart rate, restlessness and sleeplessness. It is weaker as a stimulant than amphetamine but still acts on the heart.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成顫抖、心悸、心跳加快、躁動不安與失眠。它的興奮作用比安非他命弱，但仍會影響心臟。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成颤抖、心悸、心跳加快、躁动不安与失眠。它的兴奋作用比安非他命弱，但仍会影响心脏。

fact.en: Methoxyphenamine was sold for decades as an asthma medicine, under names such as Orthoxine, before more selective inhalers replaced that kind of drug.
fact.zh: 甲氧苯丙胺曾數十年以 Orthoxine 等名稱作為氣喘藥販售，之後被選擇性更高的吸入劑取代。
fact.zhHans: 甲氧苯丙胺曾数十年以 Orthoxine 等名称作为气喘药贩售，之后被选择性更高的吸入剂取代。
